influences.name: Eric Clapton
influences.context: Eric and I had met in the early days when he was playing with John Mayall and I was playing with the Spencer Davis Group. He took me under his wing; he introduced me to his mates and we listened to records together

influences.name: T-Bone Walker
influences.context: before Steve Winwood was 15 (having played guitar in his dad's band when he was nine) he'd played keyboards with some of the pillars of blues, including T-Bone Walker, Sonny Boy Williamson, Memphis Slim and John Lee Hooker
